# Review replies, private passages and writer journey follow-up

Audited source: production `4055dbf32044d69afa0679a932e22b240117143a`.

No application code changed. Screenshots show local disposable accounts. The private-note overwrite used real local Spring/Mongo persistence; review-reply delays/failures used schema-valid browser fixtures. No production content was written and no email or social message delivered externally.

Measurements include successful writer create/autosave/preview/publish, live-vs-draft isolation, comparison, and release-update journeys. Planning scene create/edit/list/timeline/delete, Story Bible create/reveal-preview/delete and private writer note expand/create/edit/delete journeys also completed. These checks do not imply acceptance of every scenario. Selector mistakes are excluded from findings. The canonical outstanding coverage ledger remains in the round-three directory and will be updated after these checks finish.

Each screenshot is an actual browser capture, not generated art. Native iPhone/Web Share behavior remains unverified. The audit stays open.
